summary: End-to-end verification of Bimbel AELC security hardening + new UI features. Backend: 11/11 pytest passed in /app/backend/tests/test_security_and_features.py — login returns backup_email field, /auth/session removed (404), lockout at 5th attempt returns 423 with 'Akun terkunci', PUT /auth/backup-email requires correct current password (401 on wrong), OTP request works + immediate re-request returns 429, change-password weak pw rejected (400), wrong OTP rejected (400), happy-path change-password (seeded OTP) rotates token/pw_version → old token 401 → login with new pw works → restored to AelcAdmin2026 as required, teacher.available_slots persist as 'Monday|10.00 - 11.00', schedule POST validates 404/409/all 6 days. Frontend (Playwright, admin cred): Login page has NO google-login-btn, has login-internal-notice, wrong pw shows 'X percobaan tersisa'. Teachers 'Tambah Guru' dialog shows 'Jam Mengajar' label with 6 day groups (Monday–Saturday), each exactly 7 slot checkboxes; slot-day-all-Monday toggles all 7 ('7 slot dipilih'), single slot-Tuesday-13001400 works ('1 slot dipilih'). Teacher rows show per-day chips with 'Senin'/'Selasa'. Schedules grid: only teacher's times displayed, add-schedule-Monday-10.00 - 11.00 present on available cell, unavailable-Wednesday-10.00 - 11.00 shows — with no add button. Added a 3-word-name student 'Budi Santoso Wijaya' + allocation → schedule card renders as '#1 Budi Santoso' (shortName 2 words, Wijaya excluded). Two schedules added across days, both persist after page reload. Invoice BILL TO order verified: Nama < Tgl. Lahir < Sekolah < No HP (positions 7<26<49<56). 'Save to PDF' triggered without error toasts. Pengaturan page shows Keamanan Akun with backup-email-card + change-password-card; cp-request-otp enabled (backup email set); cp-submit with weak password shows validation toast 'Password baru minimal 8 karakter, wajib ada huruf besar, huruf kecil, dan angka'. All test seed data cleaned up. Admin password RESTORED to AelcAdmin2026 (via seeded OTP twice).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py next_invoice_no fallback (student path) collides when two allocations exist for same student — noted in prev iteration, still present.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event startup/shutdown — should migrate to lifespan handlers (non-blocking).
Schedules PDF export forces A4 landscape but paginates via html2canvas; large tables may split awkwardly (non-blocking, matches request).

CORS: allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True; browsers reject wildcard when credentials true. Frontend uses Bearer tokens so cookies not required; but recommend explicit origins for prod.
Rate limit on OTP request (60s) uses server clock only; would be defeated by concurrent requests. Consider Mongo unique constraint or atomic upsert.
login_attempts uses email as identifier — good; but no IP-based limiter, still susceptible to distributed brute force. Acceptable for internal admin.
change-password sets cookie with SameSite=None+Secure but returns token in body too — frontend stores new token in localStorage; OK.
